construction_review.reviewers: Three delegated construction agents, requested model gpt-6-luna
construction_review.scope: Annotated speakers, source routes, profiles, lore and initial split assignments. Per-conversation notes record source reasoning.

implementing_review.scope: Read each retained source conversation alongside selectors; checked speaker changes, target completeness, source branches and scene assumptions. Revised faction attribution, future context, narration-tag punctuation and connective prompts. Checked selected profile/lore citations and knowledge boundaries. Rebuilt all records mechanically from pinned source spans.

human_review.scope: PR review requested. No claim that the owner approved individual samples.

independent_peer_review.scope: Construction and implementing review are not blinded evaluator validation.

overlap_review.rule: Actual conversations and known repeated/branch variants stay together. Shared themes, mission chains and factual lore do not force a shared split.
overlap_review.mechanical_checks: Exact normalized assistant replies/paragraphs of at least twelve words across all split histories, plus partial twelve-word phrases and system/target phrase matches.
overlap_review.manual_checks: Reviewed selected alternate routes and source encounters. Separate mission events remain separate conversation IDs. The known calibration source conversations remain validation; Kuwaru Efreti is a separate Quarg encounter and is training material.
overlap_review.limitation: No exhaustive search for semantic paraphrases across all upstream dialogue.
